policy: On 2026-10-12 (Pacific/Auckland), the owner expressly approved the actual illustrated five-tab browser screenshots for PR #613 as the 2026.10.11.7 visual design baseline, after prior review of the real Chromium before/current/diff captures (Mobile Browser QA run 38124953118, archived artifact 11696354899), not merely the generated mockup direction. Immutable reference visual-baseline/2026.10.11.7 is pinned to candidate commit 91a0e07b50d939e238c145901491d2c65821c16d, whose learner-facing browser runtime files match the owner-reviewed ba2790e83579e9ecd856fa3214e69b3199618edc design; only release documentation, evidence ledgers, tests and workflow configuration changed between them. Keep strict <=12 diff pixels, all 4 governed viewport sizes and 13 technical screenshot surfaces including lesson, assessment, Book and listening, so the baseline protects the complete browser layout; approval covers the illustrated five-tab visual redesign, not any uninspected technical data, external physical-device or assistive technology check. Retain visual-baseline/2026.10.11.6 immutable for audit. This design approval does not authorize production-root deployment, machine control, physical iOS/Android, human NVDA/VoiceOver, SME, NZQA/provider, learner-outcome or Windows signing validations. No status gate is to be marked PASS without separately successful exact-head automated checks.
